en: A multiview color postcard showing scenes from Romania's Black Sea coast: a port with cranes and ships, modern seaside hotels and resort buildings, landscaped gardens with a pond, and city views. A yellow vertical band reads ROMÂNIA and another yellow panel says Litoralul MĂRII NEGRE. The reverse has Romanian postal markings and a Constanța origin, addressed to Bucharest.
